name: BK8
note: Title sponsor of Gresini Racing MotoGP for the 2025 and 2026 seasons: announced by Gresini Racing on 2025-02-24 (naming rights plus, in the team's words, 'prominent visibility on the Desmosedici GP24, as well as on the racing suits'; BK8 NEWS described as a sports news and entertainment platform, with managing director Michael Gatt quoted). Confirmed for 2026 at the team's Kuala Lumpur launch (MotoGP.com, 2026-01-31: 'Hosted by title sponsor BK8 News'; BK8 News's own site describes a sports media platform). Ownership not sourced: bk8.com blocks scripted access (HTTP 403). Industry review sites (blackjackinfo.com, casinofy.com, AskGamblers) say the BK8 casino is operated by Black Hawk Technology B.V. of Curaçao (company number 164452); a UK 'Black Hawk Technology Co. Ltd' (Companies House 12618662, sole director and person with significant control Cheah Hoong Ooi, 75% or more of shares and voting rights, notified 2020-05-22) carries the same name - but no opened source ties either company to the BK8 brand, so no ownership claim was written. Leads for a maintainer: Curaçao gaming register for Black Hawk Technology B.V.; Malta business registry for BK8's Malta operations.
